results.content: OSF | Maximizing accuracy of forced alignment for spontaneous child speech Wiki * Maximizing accuracy of forced alignment for spontaneous child speech ### Links to this project ### Home ### Menu ### Purpose Sociophonetic study of large speech corpora generally requires the use of forced alignment --- the automatic process of determining the start and end time of each speech sound within the recording --- in order to facilitate large-scale automated extraction of acoustic measurements of targeted vowels or consonants. Although there is an extensive literature evaluating alignment accuracy of a number of forced alignment tools and procedures, these evaluations use adult speech data, often elicited in a controlled laboratory environment. ### Method We evaluated three commonly used forced aligners, the Montreal Forced Aligner (MFA), the Hidden Markov Model Toolkit (HTK) integration provided by the LaBB-CAT corpus analysis tool, and the Penn Aligner (P2FA), using different configurations to force align non-rhotic child speech elicited in a preschool environment. ### Purpose Sociophonetic study of large speech corpora generally requires the use of forced alignment --- the automatic process of determining the start and end time of each speech sound within the recording --- in order to facilitate large-scale automated extraction of acoustic measurements of targeted vowels or consonants. I'm using Azure Data Factory to build some file to db imports and one of the requirements I have is if a file isn't valid. e.g. either a column is missing or contains incorrect data (wrong data type, lookup doesn't exist in a db) then an alert is sent detailing the errors. This doc () describes a way of using conditional splits to add custom validation that would certainly work to allow me to import the good data and write the bad data to another file with custom error messages. As far as I can tell, this will result in the data flow reporting success and to do something like calling a logic app to send an email needs to be done in the pipeline rather than data flow.
